in_marathi.name: Surajpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Sun God's Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surajpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Surajpal is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: ‘Suraj’ meaning ‘Sun God’ and ‘Pal’ meaning ‘power’. This name is a tribute to the Sun God and signifies the strength and power that comes from him.
